# commit author identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:commitAuthorIdentity`](gmeow-commitAuthorIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commitAuthorIdentity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The recorded author identity of a commit — the raw historical bytes. Distinct from [`gmeow:authoredBy`](gmeow-authoredBy.md), which points to the canonical agent currently understood to have authored the changes.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md) -> [`gmeow:AuthorIdentity`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorIdentity.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:commitAuthorIdentity`](gmeow-commitAuthorIdentity.md) from [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md) to [`gmeow:AuthorIdentity`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorIdentity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Commit History

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/software/examples/commit-history.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/software/examples/commit-history.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-software-examples-commit-history)#example-slices-extensions-software-examples-commit-history

```turtle
# --- Two commits forming a DAG (commit2's ancestor is commit1). Each commit is
#     content-addressed by its git hash (gmeow:contentDigest).
ex:commit1 a gmeow:Commit ;
    gmeow:commitInRepository   ex:repo ;
    gmeow:commitAuthorIdentity ex:danaGitId ;
    gmeow:contentDigest        "git:9f4d2a1c8e7b6f5a0d3c2b1e9f8a7d6c5b4a3e2f" .

ex:commit2 a gmeow:Commit ;
    gmeow:commitInRepository   ex:repo ;
    gmeow:commitAuthorIdentity ex:danaGitId ;
    gmeow:commitAncestor       ex:commit1 ;
    gmeow:contentDigest        "git:1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b" .
```
